'''Chandrakant''' was the smaller of the two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. Like the rest of the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector's]] [[Chandrila system/Legends|Chandrila system]],<ref name="Strongholds" /> it was located on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], which served as a dividing line between the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] and [[Arrowhead]] portions of the Core Worlds.<ref name="TEAChandrila" />

The moon, which was only a fraction of the size of its fellow moon [[Chandra/Legends|Chandra]], was covered in [[Color/Legends|amber-colored]] [[Gas/Legends|gases]] that reflected a dull, golden light and were [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] to most [[Species/Legends|species]]. Chandrakant's name meant "counterpoint" in the [[Chandrilan (language)/Legends|Chandrilan]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chandrila's two moons were first mentioned in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'',<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> but Chandrakant was not named separately until the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' expansion ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]], published for use with the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]] system.<ref name="Strongholds" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Chandrila [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Chandrakant, in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEAChandrila" />
